pre_cutoff_evidence_records.title: H.R. 4346 final Senate amendment text
pre_cutoff_evidence_records.summary: The operative congressional text established semiconductor manufacturing incentives and a 25 percent advanced manufacturing investment credit for qualified investment.
pre_cutoff_evidence_records.notes: Congress.gov identifies the text version by legislative date; noon UTC is a date-normalization placeholder, not a claimed publication time.

pre_cutoff_evidence_records.title: H.R. 4346 legislative actions
pre_cutoff_evidence_records.summary: The House concurred in the Senate amendment by a 243-187 vote at 3:10 p.m. Eastern on July 28, 2022, completing congressional passage.

pre_cutoff_evidence_records.title: Intel Announces Next US Site with Landmark Investment in Ohio
pre_cutoff_evidence_records.summary: Intel announced more than $20 billion for two Ohio fabs and stated that the scope and pace of the expansion would depend heavily on CHIPS Act funding; it also named several expected suppliers.
pre_cutoff_evidence_records.notes: The source page supplies the publication date; noon UTC is a date-normalization placeholder.

pre_cutoff_evidence_records.summary: Intel had publicly scheduled second-quarter results for promptly after the July 28 market close, before the canonical next-session opening entry.

expected_direction.fundamental_policy_effect: positive for Intel's U.S. manufacturing capital economics
expected_direction.diagnostic_expectation: Intel may benefit fundamentally, but its immediate stock path is not attributable to the law because a scheduled earnings event occurs before entry.

sealed_memo.economic_mechanism: The legislation lowers eligible domestic semiconductor-fab capital costs through a 25 percent advanced manufacturing investment credit and authorizes direct financial assistance, loans and loan guarantees. Intel had already announced a large U.S. fab program explicitly dependent on CHIPS funding.
sealed_memo.materiality_basis: Intel's announced Ohio investment exceeded $20 billion. A 25 percent credit on qualifying investment and potential direct assistance are economically material, although the full announced amount cannot be assumed to qualify.
sealed_memo.expected_realization_horizon: Policy support and award processes within 24 months; fab construction and operating cash-flow effects over multiple years.
sealed_memo.primary_trade_expression: No canonical trade. Preserve INTC versus SOXX next-open 1-, 5-, 20- and 60-session performance as diagnostics only.
sealed_memo.benchmark: SOXX, selected before outcome review as the matching U.S.-listed semiconductor industry ETF.
sealed_memo.entry_rule: No entry. The publicly scheduled Intel earnings release between passage and the next regular-session open triggers the frozen invalid-regime rule.
sealed_memo.exit_rule: No trade exit. Record the canonical 1-, 5-, 20- and 60-session marks from the next regular-session open solely as non-executable diagnostics.
